decision_reason: M1155 may only design family-intersection and behavior diagnostics for alpha_0_05. It cannot train actor weights, run PPO, run replay, run behavior eval, mine rows, promote, use private holdout, change actor inputs, skip family-intersection replay, or treat M1154 first replay as promotion evidence.
failure_criteria: actor training, PPO, replay, behavior eval, mining, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change starts
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat M1154 first replay as promotion evidence
hypothesis: The M1154 alpha_0_05 first-replay candidate should next be tested on family-intersection replay and behavior diagnostics before any promotion, PPO, or private holdout.

blocked_by: M1154 first replay candidate is not promotable without family and behavior diagnostics
invalidates: promotion from M1154 first replay alone
PPO from alpha_0_05 before family/behavior diagnostics
private holdout before public proof diagnostics
parent_objective: design family-intersection and behavior diagnostics for the M1154 selected alpha

public_gates: M1155 must not train actor weights
M1155 must not run behavior eval
M1155 must not mine new rows
M1155 must not use private holdout
success_criteria: M1061 family-intersection replay scope is explicit
no actor training, PPO, replay, behavior eval, mining, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change occurs
